Name: Aquatic Sea Fish
Author: LucyTheDove
Description:
[b]🦀 Dive Into New Waters

[/b]Bring the spirit of the sea to Stardew Valley with 33 new oceanic and island fish! Aquatic Sea Fish (ASF) is a mod designed to add vanilla-friendly fish to all of Stardew Valley's oceans, this mod expands your fishing adventures without breaking game progression.

[b]Enjoying this mod?[/b] Consider scrolling up and clicking the [b]endorse [/b]button, it goes a long way and helps the mod grow! 💝


[b]🌊  Features:[/b]

🐟 33+ unique fish inspired by ocean and island life
💬 38+ new dialogue and generic lines for Willy
📜 50+ new and unique quests from all NPCs
🧡 18+ new quests when compatible mods are installed (learn more in Fishing Guide below)
⚖️ Balanced for difficulty, sell price, and spawn rates
🔍 Works perfectly with vanilla fishing mechanics
📝 Compatible with all existing fishing levels, professions, and mods
🧭 Designed for exploration and discovery, no early game imbalance


[b]🐬 Installation:[/b]

This mod is ready to go right out of the box, while also compatible with any existing save of Stardew Valley 1.6+
No new save needed, simply drag and drop it into your Mods folder.

Steps:
[left]
[list]
[*]Download and extract the mod’s .zip file[/*]
[*]Place the folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods[/*]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed (required for mods)[/*]
[*]Launch the game and cast your line[/*]
[/list]

Fish, quests, and more can now be found in the [b]Fishing Guide[/b] at the[i][b] bottom [/b][b]of the[/b] [b]page[/b][/i], [i]scroll down to check it out!

[/left]

[b]
❓ Q&A

Q:[/b] What if I’m already in Year 3+?
[b]A:[/b] All quests will be safe, but you may miss a few non-important early-game letters.

[b]Q:[/b] Does this support Stardew Aquarium?
[b]A:[/b] Not yet! Integration depends on the Aquarium mod’s authors, but it may happen in the future.

[b]Q:[/b] How can I do a specific quest?
[b]A:[/b] Scroll down to the bottom of the page to see how it can be activated!

[b]Q:[/b] Are there any universally loved gifts?
[b]A:[/b] Yes! The Mermaid's Pearl, and the Mermaid's Tear, both sell for handsome amounts as well.

[b]Q: [/b]Are quests added when other mods are installed?
[b]A:[/b] Yup! When SVE, Ridgeside, East Scarp, Tilly Librarian, or Arumi the Actress mods are installed, quests are added for character(s) in each mod! The mod removes all data related to them when uninstalled, that way no glitched data is ever present. : )
